title: Median-of-R(k)/S_unit(k) singular-series fit (2C2) — kmax=80 precision check
context: E62 (kmax=40, N=1e6) and E63 (kmax=40, N=1e7) both PASS G3 with the median estimator (1.395/1.451 and 1.459/1.470 vs 1.32032±0.15), but both CIs cover 1.32032 comfortably — robust, imprecise. E64 doubles the bin count (kmax=80, 40 even bins) at N=1e6 to test whether the fixed 20-bin set is the precision bottleneck. Same estimator, same gates, only kmax changes.
verdict: MISS — G3 miss: 0.933/1.075 vs 1.32032±0.15 (E62 kmax=40 1.395/1.451, Δ -0.312). Wider kmax destabilised the fit; revert to kmax=40.
